liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Casey Jones** (3 reviews): Opening song not played since 1974, followed by Dupree's Diamond Blues, a rarity since 1969; The opening performance was described as sloppy but hot, instantly converting the listener into a Deadhead [7][10][15]
- **Dupree's Diamond Blues** (1 review): Played after an eight-year hiatus, the band jammed on even when they forgot the words [13]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Jerry Garcia is described as inspired during this performance [7]

## The recordings

- **gd1977-10-02.sbd.cantor.gmb.86354.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 164 min; rated 4.82/5 by 17 [1]
- **gd77-10-02.sbd.unknown.278.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 163 min; rated 4.82/5 by 44 [4]. Said about its sound: The sound is described as crisp and pristine, with the band playing well throughout the show; The mix is absolutely perfect, with every instrument clearly defined in the recording; No static is present, and each instrument and voice is clearly defined in the mix [12][13][14][15][16]
- **gd1977-10-02.142120.akg.d224e.troy-smith-miller-clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 19 songs; 151 min [6]
- **gd1977-10-02.142122.sbd.miller.clugston.patched.flac1644**: soundboard; 22 songs; 163 min [2]

## Around the show

- Garcia forgot the words to the third verse, his first attempt since 1974, then soloed over it [9]
- Experienced fans on the sidewalk discussed desired songs, noting Casey Jones had not been played since 1974 [10]
- The recording is missing the Johnny B. Goode encore [6]
- The second set is called a dream set, with only Dark Star potentially improving it [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1977-10-02.sbd.cantor.gmb.86354.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Betty Cantor; transferred by Original WBOTB DATs procured & circulated in 1996 by Jace Crouch and Tim Deibert. Thanks to trailmix for providing the lineaged master DAT  for transfer..Transferred and mastered by ChrisL.; source: Betty Board (see comments) [1]. Also: Transferred from a 7-inch two-track BBD reel with DBX-1, processed through PCM501ES and Fostex D5 [1]
- **gd77-10-02.sbd.unknown.278.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [4]
- **gd1977-10-02.142120.akg.d224e.troy-smith-miller-clugston.flac2496**: taped by Sandy Troy; transferred by Matt Smith, Charlie Miller, Scott Clugston; source: Sandy Troy's Master 10" Audience Reels (Sony TC-755); AKG D224E mics [6]
- **gd1977-10-02.142122.sbd.miller.clugston.patched.flac1644**: transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Master Reel > PCM > Dat [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by George Alper Grateful Dead: [1977-10-01 Paramount Theater, Portland, OR, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1977-10-01-paramount-theater-portland-or-usa/) [20]
- Poster by George Alper Grateful Dead: [1977-10-01 Paramount Theater, Portland, OR, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1977-10-01-paramount-theater-portland-or-usa/) [21]
